settings.title: Is it safe for newborns?
settings.text: Of course it’s safe for newborns. Doctors nowadays are advising to use a white noise machine.

settings.title: Does it have a timer/auto-off?
settings.text: Yes, sure. You can time it from your phone.

settings.title: Can it run all night?
settings.text: It works for 6 hours without charging it.

settings.title: Is it rechargeable or plug-in?
settings.text: It is rechargeable, but you can also use it while being plugged in.

settings.title: Does it offer lights also?
settings.text: Yes, for sure. It has all lights you may need, at all levels you wish to use (low and high lights).
